item.title: Justice Department swiftly fires lawyer chosen as top federal prosecutor for Virginia office
item.description: A lawyer picked by judges to serve as the top federal prosecutor for a Virginia office that pursued cases against foes of President Donald Trump was swiftly fired Friday by the Justice Department.

item.title: Family wants answers after 18-year-old killed in West End shooting
item.description: The family of an 18-year-old man shot and killed at a Henrico County apartment complex Sunday night is seeking answers about the investigation five days after his death.

item.title: Family displaced after van crashes into South Richmond home
item.description: A family is displaced after a van crashed into their South Richmond home Friday evening, officials at the scene told CBS 6.
